NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_NARAKU_EVENT.title: Naraku
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_NARAKU_EVENT.pages.IN: Ninja Slayer tosses and turns beneath the blanket of his own mind.
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_NARAKU_EVENT.pages.CA: Fuyuko and Tochinoki cry out from somewhere close within the smoke. Fujikido reaches for them and finds only a sharper nightmare.
The same Christmas night burns again. Naraku fans the pain into black flame and waits for Fujikido to surrender his body.
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_NARAKU_EVENT.pages.AC: His wife and son vanish into the flames once more. Naraku chuckles in the depths of his neurons: surrender the body, and the vengeance may continue.
Fujikido loosens his grip on the reins of self. Red-black flame floods his body, and Naraku's laughter merges with his breath.
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_NARAKU_EVENT.pages.SI: "Silence, Naraku." Fujikido speaks his own name and rises from the nightmare on a deep, Chado-like breath.
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_DARK_NINJA_EVENT.page: The dark cloak stands in the stone chamber. Empty! Killing intent strikes from behind. "Domo, Ninja Slayer-san. Dark Ninja desu." "Domo, Dark Ninja-san. Ninja Slayer desu." A shuriken pierces the cloak. GOURANGA! The true body already waits at Ninja Slayer's landing point! Death Slash closes in!
Dark Ninja withdraws Death Slash and assumes an iaijutsu stance. The killing intent in the chamber becomes tangible.
Ninja Slayer evades Death Slash and withdraws from the chamber. Among Kyoto Castle's debris, he finds 100 Gold.
Dark Ninja's temporary body dissolves into zeroes and ones from the wound. Blade, cloak, and cold smile vanish in turn, all reclaimed by Kyoto Castle's circuitry deep within the stone walls.
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_YAMOTO_KOKI_CUTE_EVEN: Yamoto Koki temporarily joins your party!
Yamoto Koki runs away crying after being robbed!
